source.title: India & Southeast Asia Merchandise Collaboration Announcement
source.content:
We are extremely excited to be partnering with Cubelelo to introduce official WCA Merchandise! Cubelelo will be our merchandise partner for the Southeast Asia & India region. We are starting off by releasing a t-shirt that you can currently purchase on [Cubelelo's website](https://www.cubelelo.com/collections/cubing-top-wear/products/official-world-cube-association-t-shirt).
<!-- break -->
Stay tuned for more announcements about merchandise availability in more regions in the future! 

To help bring our merchandise to more areas, we are looking for other organizations or people that would be interested in becoming WCA merchandise partners. Please reach out to the [WCA Marketing Team](mailto:marketing@worldcubeassociation.org) if you or your organization is interested.

translation.title: 印度及东南亚周边商品合作公告
translation.content:
我们很高兴与 Cubelelo 合作，推出 WCA 官方周边商品！Cubelelo 将成为我们在东南亚及印度地区的周边合作伙伴。首款商品是一件 T 恤，目前已可在 [Cubelelo 网站](https://www.cubelelo.com/collections/cubing-top-wear/products/official-world-cube-association-t-shirt)购买。

今后我们将在更多地区推出周边商品，请留意后续公告！

为让更多地区可以买到我们的周边，我们正在寻找有意成为 WCA 周边合作伙伴的组织或个人。如你或你的组织有兴趣，请联系 [WCA 市场营销组](mailto:marketing@worldcubeassociation.org)。
